snippet.description:
LiberNovo Black Friday Early Access: Limited gift cards for up to $100 USD extra off on top of Black Friday prices! Omni from $609 USD (up to 39% off) and Maxis from $1,299 USD (up to 42% off). Starts Nov 9, 6 PM PST: https://libernovo.com/?ref=LMG

Bulk orders: up to 42% off, plus an extra $180 off for every $4,000 spent, starting Nov 9, 6 PM PST: https://libernovo.com/pages/bulk-order?ref=LMG

Check out the Nanoleaf lighting products we used in our setups: https://links.nanoleaf.me/linustech

It’s been years, but thanks to our sponsors Libernovo and Nanoleaf, we’re finally giving the LTT writers a MASSIVE office upgrade! Did I say giving? I meant, they’re DOING the upgrade themselves. Which… May have been a terrible mistake… But hey, it also gave us an opportunity to peek behind the curtain, meet some of the newer faces on the team, and tour the space where all the magic actually happens.

Discuss on the forum: https://linustechtips.com/topic/1644328-i-let-my-staff-upgrade-the-office-they-almost-ruined-it/

- Grab an ATLAS ergonomic office chair:  https://lmg.gg/secretlablttatlas
